selection.method: Highest-risk recoverable past per-reading labels: changed/quarantined identities, mismatches with earlier reports and recent owner reviews, then current-model disagreement. Deterministic rank/key order; cap eight per fic; consolidate identical current claims at the same citation. Each selected context manually inspected. No label changes.
selection.scores: Current committed per-hit confidence model with current reliability; in-sample scores, not held-out probabilities. Assistant scores are subjective.
selection.scope: All stored label/review files inventoried; only 51 previously age-screened available sources replayed. Unmatched keys are not assumed false negatives; uncertain/retired labels do not become training labels. Positive inventories never reject omitted hints.
